integrity: The limit proof is analytic. Finite recurrence computations reproduce source values and serve only as regression checks; they are not used as evidence for the infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: The exact constant \(C\) concerns the shortest order-preserving subcycle of the canonical dice family, not the unrestricted minimum \(n(N)\).
The unrestricted result is a liminf/limsup bracket; existence of \(\lim n(N)/\sqrt N\) is not proved.
A differently phrased prior analysis of the same greedy recurrence remains a residual literature risk.
title: Sharp asymptotic length of the canonical optimal-dominance dice subcycle
